notes: MUST be set to momentary (1 learn press) before use. LINE-POWERED: AC IN L is both its supply and the line side of its relay, so it stays permanently live and the unit sits at the head of the rung. AC OUT L is switched AC IN L — NOT a dry contact; the N pair is a bonded common bus. Do NOT copy the manufacturer diagram's direct-to-coil wiring: it bypasses the seal-in and violates SR-4.
